# Lecture Notes

## Double Categories

<b>Definition 1.1</b> (Double category) <i>
A <u> double category </u> $\mathbb{C}$ consists of the following data:
> a category $\mathbb{C}_0$, whose objects we call 0-<u>cells</u>, and whose arrows we call <u>tight</u> 1-<u> cells</u>
$f: X \rightarrow X'$;
> a category $\mathbb{C}_1$, whose objects we call <u>loose</u> 1-<u>cells</u> $M: X \not\rightarrow Y$, and whose
arrows we call 2-<u>cells</u>
$$
a_{M,N,P}: (M \circ N) \circ P \Rightarrow M \circ (N \circ P)
$$
</i>
